ideas.title: Glaze Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Every egg comes out of the kiln blank. Paint it however you like, and the colours and patterns you choose decide which pet hatches from it.
core_loop: Pull a blank egg from your kiln
Paint and glaze it on the turntable
Fire it and hatch the pet your pattern unlocked
Sell spare pets to buy rarer paints and bigger kilns
ideas.twist: Secret pets only hatch from exact recipes (like gold stripes on a black egg), and players trade the recipes, not just the pets.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Eggs is the biggest open gap (9.32). Paint / create is up 2.59x (Paint to Get Rich 17.0K CCU, Kukirin Life 30.0K) and Eggs games pull 414.8K young CCU. "___ for ___" titles lead formulas at 3.41x (Climb For Animals Eggs 57.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Egg games make you break, steal or climb for eggs; here you design the egg yourself, so every hatch feels earned.

ideas.title: Chisel Rocks to Get Rich
ideas.hook: Haul a boulder to your workshop and chip away at it. The closer your statue matches the customer's order, the more they pay.
core_loop: Mine a raw boulder from the quarry
Chisel it toward the order on the board
Get scored and paid for accuracy and size
Upgrade chisels and unlock rarer stone like marble and obsidian
ideas.twist: Gems are hidden inside some boulders; carve carefully around them and the statue sells for many times more.
retention: Gallery of every statue you sold
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Stones is the second-biggest gap (8.58). Stones / rocks is the top rising theme at 2.23x (+1 Stone Skipping 29.9K, Lift Rock For Eggs 10.8K), Break / mine / dig leads mechanics at 3.15x and "___ to Get Rich" titles are up 2.03x (Make Ramen To Get Rich 6.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Rock games are about lifting or skipping stones; this turns the rock into a canvas and pays for skill, not just clicks.

ideas.title: Scrap Robots for Cores
ideas.hook: A junkyard full of broken robots. Smash them apart with your wrench and grab the glowing core inside. Rare cores power up your own scrap bot.
core_loop: Smash a robot in the junkyard
Grab the core and loose parts
Slot cores into your bot for stat boosts
Unlock deeper scrap piles with bigger robots
ideas.twist: Some robots wake up when you hit them and run off; chase them down for the rarest cores.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig × Robots is an open gap (6.31). Break / mine / dig is the fastest rising mechanic at 3.15x (Break and Steal an Egg 183.9K CCU, Smash the City 6.2K) and Robots / mechs is up 1.44x (WRONG WAY! 5.6K).
ideas.differentiator: Smash games break eggs, vaults or cities; breaking robots gives every hit a mechanical payoff and a build-your-bot goal.

ideas.title: Dig Bones for Dinos
ideas.hook: Dig fossils out of the cliff, piece the skeleton together, then paint on the skin. Finish it and the dinosaur comes alive in your park.
core_loop: Dig fossil bones in the cliff
Assemble the skeleton on the table
Paint skin and colours to bring it to life
Show dinos in your park for visitor cash
ideas.twist: Missing bones can be swapped with bones from other species, creating hybrid dinos that join a separate secret index.
retention: Weekly meteor event with limited fossils
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Dinosaurs is an open gap (6.16). Dinosaurs are rising 1.72x (Ride a Dino 15.1K, Prehistoric Farm 4.9K), Break / mine / dig is up 3.15x (Dig For Eggs 8.0K) and Paint / create is up 2.59x.
ideas.differentiator: Dino games let you ride or farm dinos; here you dig them up and design how they look before they walk.

ideas.title: Crack Hail for Gems
ideas.hook: Storms drop giant hailstones on the map. Run out with your hammer, crack them open and grab the gems frozen inside before they melt.
core_loop: Wait for the storm warning
Rush to hailstones and smash them
Each hit gives +1 strength
Spend gems on hammers and storm-proof gear
ideas.twist: Bigger storms drop bigger hail but also knock you around, so stronger players brave the worst weather for the rarest gems.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig × Disaster / weather is an open gap (5.49). Break / mine / dig is up 3.15x (+1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 9.3K) and +1 stat per action is up 1.69x (+1 Stone Skipping 29.9K, +1 Assassin Leveling 10.2K).
ideas.differentiator: Weather games make you survive storms; this one makes the storm the loot drop players run toward.

ideas.title: Blow Glass to Get Rich
ideas.hook: Heat glass in the furnace, blow and shape it into vases and ornaments, then sell them in your shop. The hotter the fire, the fancier the glass.
core_loop: Melt glass in the furnace
Blow and shape it with simple drag controls
Add colour swirls and cool it
Sell pieces to shoppers and upgrade the furnace
ideas.twist: Elemental fuels (frost fire, lava, lightning) change the glass, unlocking glowing and crackled finishes buyers pay extra for.
retention: Collection book of every glass style
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Ice / fire / elements is an open gap (5.06). Paint / create is up 2.59x, Sell / run a shop is up 1.55x (Sell Fries! 28.6K, Make Rugs! 6.5K) and interior maps are rising 1.69x. "___ to Get Rich" titles are up 2.03x.
ideas.differentiator: Craft-and-sell games stay calm; adding elemental fire turns each piece into a risky, flashy bet.

ideas.title: Build a Pharaoh Tomb
ideas.hook: You are the royal builder. Dig out tomb chambers, paint the walls with hieroglyphs and fill them with treasure so the pharaoh pays you more.
core_loop: Dig a new chamber
Paint wall art from a stencil kit
Place treasure and traps
Earn gold from pharaoh visits and expand
ideas.twist: Other players sneak in as tomb robbers at night, so your traps and wall curses have to keep them out.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Ancient / pyramids is an open gap (5.02). Tycoon / base building is up 1.87x across 67 young games (Climb For Animals Eggs 57.3K, Build the Pyramid! 8.1K) and "Build a ___" titles are up 1.16x.
ideas.differentiator: Pyramid games stack blocks outside; this one is about the decorated rooms inside and defending them.

ideas.title: Style Critics for Stars
ideas.hook: Grumpy fashion critics march down the runway. Place stylist towers that throw outfits and makeup at them; every critic who reaches the end smiling gives you stars.
core_loop: Place stylist towers beside the runway
Style each wave of critics before they reach the judges
Earn stars and unlock new stylists
Pull for rare designer stylists
ideas.twist: Critics have taste: some only like gothic, some only pastel, so tower placement must match the outfit to the critic.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense × Fashion / beauty is an open gap (4.12). Fashion / beauty is up 1.84x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 24.7K, Makeup Salon 7.1K) and Tower defense is up 1.41x (Cameraman Tower Defense 20.7K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are judged runways and TD games are battles; this puts both on one lane and draws in a new audience for TD.

ideas.title: +1 Guitar Volume
ideas.hook: Every strum gives +1 volume. Get loud enough and your sound waves blast through walls, windows and whole buildings.
core_loop: Strum to gain +1 volume
Blast through the next wall
Reach new stages for bigger multipliers
Rebirth for louder amps
ideas.twist: Hit notes on the beat for bonus volume, so rhythm-skilled players climb faster than pure clickers.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action × Music / dance is an open gap (3.65). "+1 ___" titles are up 1.83x and the mechanic 1.69x (+1 Stone Skipping 29.9K, +1 Assassin Leveling 10.2K), Hit / swing is up 1.94x and Music / dance is up 1.48x (Piano Rhythm Tiles 5.7K).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games mostly train strength or speed; making the stat sound turns each click into a visible, audible shockwave.

ideas.title: Sew Capes to Get Rich
ideas.hook: Run the tailor shop superheroes visit. Cut, sew and paint capes and suits to order, and the better the fit, the bigger the tip.
core_loop: Take a hero's order at the counter
Cut and sew the cape or suit
Paint on the logo and colours
Get paid and expand the shop
ideas.twist: Heroes test their gear right outside; a badly made cape rips mid-flight and they come back angry.
retention: Weekly villain-attack event needing quick repairs
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Superheroes / powers is an open gap (3.12). Sell / run a shop is up 1.55x (Sell Fries! 28.6K, Make Rugs! 6.5K), Paint / create 2.59x and Superheroes / powers 1.30x (Superhero Arena 9.8K). "___ to Get Rich" titles are up 2.03x.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games are about fighting; this is the cozy shop behind the heroes, a new angle on a fighting theme.
